name: True Happiness
overview: True happiness, according to Scripture, is found in trusting the LORD and living according to His ways rather than following ungodly counsel or sinful paths. The Psalms affirm that blessedness comes from delighting in the goodness of God and placing confidence in Him. Wisdom and understanding in handling life's matters lead to genuine joy, while the pursuit of mere pleasure apart from God is ultimately empty, as Ecclesiastes reveals. Even in times of prosperity and adversity, rejoicing and doing good are part of God's design for a fulfilled life.
